item.title: Looking Forward to 2022; The Ease of Being a Cynic
item.author: Michael Park
item.description: My goals for 2022 are nothing out of the ordinary; apart from having some of them be to actually travel somewhere of relatively far distance in a hopefully more open world. The main goal that should hopefully help drive the rest is optimism
